decision_rule.note: Same rule for every system, fixed before any run; taken from the tracker/settled-table vote thresholds (README section 4).

splits.train_sessions: every 2026-10-12 .. 2026-10-16 session except the dev part
splits.dev: the three 2026-10-15 sessions + 2026-10-16 clips with an odd shot number (used only for temperature scaling and the training-curve log; no threshold or hyper-parameter search)

strongest_candidate_rule: Fixed before any test run: on all verified held-out test pictures, the challenger with more correct confident identities among those whose confidently-wrong count is not above the frozen reader's; if neither qualifies, the one with fewer confidently-wrong identities. Both challengers are still passed through the product evaluation and reported; the rule only names the primary one.
